findings.title: Missing Canonical Tags
findings.description: 1 indexable page(s) lack a canonical URL tag.
findings.impact: Vulnerability to duplicate content penalties if URLs are accessible with query parameters or trailing slashes.

findings.title: Missing Meta Descriptions
findings.impact: Search engines will generate arbitrary text snippets from page content, hurting SERP CTR.
